issues.quote: is renewed automatically for further periods of three (3) years; it cannot be terminated before the end of a period
issues.reason: The initial term of three years is within the limit. But the Agreement renews automatically for further three-year periods, and nothing lets either Party stop the renewal by notice. Under ruling R-2026-01, a renewal that cannot be stopped by notice is TERM_TOO_LONG. Because the Agreement may never end, the three-year survival period that runs from its end may never start either. Counsel should ask for a right to stop the renewal by notice, or for a fixed term of no more than three years.
